corrections.text: The article attributes the sentence "Vaultwarden works great, but the problem is with keeping well-maintained OSS clients distributed through the various app stores and browser stores." to a forum user named fptbb. The forum thread shows that this comment was written by a user named jzebedee.

The article says the announcement post's edit lists "Bitwarden is not going closed-source" and "You can still fork Bitwarden". Those exact phrases do not appear in the post as preserved. The edit's wording is "Bitwarden is still open source" and "Bitwarden code can still be forked, even the commercial license code", alongside "Nothing has been made closed source."

The article refers to RyanL and dwbit only as "a user named" and "a poster named". The forum labels both accounts "Bitwarden Employee". The announcement post was also edited on October 12, 2026, after this article was written, to add that new enterprise features, new products and other items providing a strategic competitive edge in new markets will be behind the commercial license, in most cases for business plans only, with some premium-plan features decided case by case; the article's statement that feature scope is described only as a case-by-case decision predates that edit.
